Headerless raw-binary analysis uses the caller-supplied architecture and entry address; file offset 0 is mapped at that address. Headers are not discovered from file bytes.

Little-endian generic Ghidra languages are used for x86, x86_64, arm, arm64, and NMOS 6502. Big-endian, Thumb-only, Cortex-M, 65C02, 65816, and other processor variants are unsupported in this increment.
Static analysis does not emulate reset vectors, memory-mapped I/O, or firmware boot sequences.

diagnostics: Only resolved Ghidra call references are returned; unresolved computed or indirect calls remain unknown, while function classifications distinguish thunks and externals.
limitations: Ghidra's callee inventory omits targets of 413 call reference(s) or decoded call(s) without destinations.

records.note: Decompiler output is not original source. Raw imports use GCC analysis signatures; original Win64 instructions govern arguments and fallback tail jumps.
